name: Direct Voxel Grid Optimization (DVGO)
definition: A differentiable volume rendering method that combines ray sampling, coordinate rescaling, voxel grid interpolation for density and color, and volume rendering into a single forward pass.
summary: Direct Voxel Grid Optimization is a differentiable volume rendering method that replaces NeRF's MLP with direct 3D voxel grids for density and color, enabling significantly faster training and inference.
